        countryIso

        name
      }

      isOpen
    }

      daysShort
      hours
      isOpen
    }

{"operationName":"getCustomerPreferredStore","variables":{"userLoginId":"koala.ocbuu@gmail.com"},"query":"query getCustomerPreferredStore($userLoginId: String!) {
  getCustomerPreferredStore(userLoginId: $userLoginId) {
    address {
      avsVerified
      billingAddress
      cnC
      country {
        isocode
        name
      }
      defaultAddress
      email
      firstName
      formattedAddress
      id
      lastName
      line1
      line2
      newOrEditedAddress
      phone
      poBox
      postalCode
      region {
        countryIso
        isocode
        isocodeShort
        name
      }
      restrictedPostcode
      shippingAddress
      town
      visibleInAddressBook
    }
    bopisStore
    curbsidePickupAllowed
    instorePickupAllowed
    isInstorePickupAllowed
    isSameDayDelivery
    shopByAppointment
    displayName
    geoPoint {
      latitude
      longitude
    }
    name
    storeId
    todayOpeningHours {
      daysShort
      hours
      isOpen
    }
    weekOpeningHours {
      daysShort
      hours
      isOpen
    }
  }
}
"}
